annotation.title_clean: Council Decision (EU) 2025/800 establishing the position to be taken on behalf of the European Union within the Joint Committee as regards the adoption of a decision adding a newly adopted Union act to Annex 2 to the Windsor Framework
annotation.title_en: Council Decision (EU) 2025/800 establishing the position to be taken on behalf of the European Union within the Joint Committee as regards the adoption of a decision adding a newly adopted Union act to Annex 2 to the Windsor Framework
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Council Decision setting the EU position in the EU-UK Joint Committee to add the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689), as regards product placing-on-market conditions and technical specifications, to Annex 2 of the Windsor Framework for Northern Ireland, excluding Articles 102, 108 and 110. Articles 103-107 and 109 already apply.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU position in Joint Committee is the attached draft decision.
AI Act provisions on conditions and technical specifications for placing products on the market added to Windsor Framework Annex 2, point 47 'Other'.
Articles 102, 108 and 110 of the AI Act are excluded.
Articles 103-107 and 109 already apply under Article 13(3) of the Windsor Framework.
Decision enters into force on adoption; Joint Committee decision on the day after adoption.
